title: Applying a Released Survivor Share to an Overpayment Outstanding — Income Annuities
content:
The overpayment outstanding on an Ashgrove Income Annuities contract is the overpayments recorded on the contract less the recoveries recorded against them. When a survivor share is released from a held installment:

- **Overpayment outstanding, payments continuing.** When an overpayment stands unrecovered on the contract and payments continue to a survivor or beneficiary (contract status survivor continuing or beneficiary continuing), the amount applied to it is the tier's overpayment offset maximum percentage (25%) of the released survivor share, rounded to the cent and never more than the overpayment outstanding.
- **Overpayment outstanding, no payments continuing.** When an overpayment stands unrecovered and no payments continue, the whole released share is applied to it, never more than the overpayment outstanding.
- Where no overpayment stands unrecovered, neither applies.

The amount applied is recovered against the deposit whose overpayment it settles, and it reduces the amount sent.

### Cases (hypothetical released share $1,000.00)

| Overpayments recorded | Recoveries recorded | Outstanding | Status | Applied |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| $1,350.00 | $975.00 | $375.00 | Survivor continuing | 25% of $1,000.00 is $250.00 |
| $1,350.00 | $1,250.00 | $100.00 | Survivor continuing | $100.00 (never more than outstanding) |
| $1,350.00 | $975.00 | $375.00 | Completed | $375.00 (whole share, capped at outstanding) |
| $1,350.00 | $1,350.00 | $0.00 | Survivor continuing | Neither applies |
